review.sender_goal_compatibility_axis: Both delivered and emitted histograms and same-code joint counts checked equal before retaining one row/map.
review.paired_worlds: Uses one actual world, one delivered code, independent query menus and complementary goal order; action→physical-place routing and target correctness independently checked.
review.blocked_domain: All49-code U is labeled counterfactual; actual allowed-message coverage is computed only from[0,0]. Nonzero delivered message is rejected.
review.marginal_categories: Joint / both marginals without joint / food only / water only / neither are mutually exclusive and complete.
review.denominators: Per lambda heldout:144 map-direction units,2304 unique protocol photo/map/direction cases,23040 actual endpoint worlds. Four seeds remain the independent units.
review.aggregation: Balanced rates equal equal-weight per-seed averages; pooled failure shares are explicitly count-weighted and not automatically per-seed means.
review.interpretation: New U and failure decomposition are post-hoc. N uses16 separate protocol photo pairs; J comes from real endpoint worlds. No photo-wise N-vs-J subtraction or language-formation inference.
